name: Itomaki Yarn
description: Itomaki Yarn — a WooCommerce store theme for a small yarn shop in an old merchant house, set like a poster. A formal white top header carries the shop name on the left, the main menu centred and the Shop the yarn button, account and cart on the right (a full-screen red menu on phones). Kankurenai red (#E95464) is the main colour: the hero field, every page head, the shop-board card, the farm card and the footer strip are red fields with plum-black ink type on rose-white paper. The hero is a diagonal split: a red field cut on a diagonal over a watercolour of the shop, the shop line set as a giant poster headline (a vertical line beside it in Chinese and Japanese), and a cut-out spool of red yarn (transparent WebP) sitting on the seam and breaking over the hero's bottom edge. Five steps from fleece to spool stand as giant red numerals; a full-bleed watercolour of the hill farm carries a red card that a cut-out skein breaks out of. Soft watercolour illustrations throughout. Hachi Maru Pop for display, Nunito for reading. Sample content and products in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical lines only in Chinese and Japanese. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-6 (poster-typographic, diagonal-split hero, centered nav, cutout-break-frame, watercolour, kankurenai #E95464, Hachi Maru Pop + Nunito, yarn shop in shops-hobbies). A formal white top header: the shop name on the left, the main menu centred in the bar, the Shop the yarn button, account and cart on the right (a full-screen red menu below 1024 px). Poster-typographic: giant Hachi Maru Pop headlines (hero, steps, page heads) and giant red step numerals; a huge pale thread character behind the hero type. Diagonal-split hero: a kankurenai red field cut on a diagonal over a watercolour of the shop. Watercolour: every picture is a soft watercolour raster illustration. Break-frame: the cut-out spool of red yarn (transparent WebP) sits on the diagonal seam between the red field and the shop watercolour and breaks over the hero's bottom edge into the shop board; a cut-out skein breaks out of the red card over the top edge of the full-bleed hill-farm band; the spool also breaks over the diagonal bottom edge of every page head. Images generated with Grok Build. Sample content and products in en, zh-TW, ja, fr and de; vertical lines only in zh and ja. Contrast: plum-black ink #200C10 on kankurenai #E95464 5.3:1 (all text on the red hero field, page heads, the board card, the farm card, the header button and the footer strip); white on kankurenai 3.5:1 only for the giant hero headline (large text, 3:1 rule); ink on rose-white paper #FFF8F7 17.9:1, on white 18.7:1 and on blush #FCE6E8 15.7:1; deep madder #A8243A on paper 6.7:1, on white 7.1:1 and on blush 5.9:1 (links, prices, labels; white on deep 7.1:1); mauve grey #6A474D on paper 7.6:1 and on white 8.0:1 (secondary text); white on ink 18.7:1 and pale rose #F7C3C9 on ink 12.1:1 (buttons, chips, footer); kankurenai on paper 3.4:1 only for the giant step numerals (large text); deep madder on kankurenai 2.0:1, never used for text.

summary.zh-TW: 韓紅色的手染毛線店：海報般的大字標題、斜切分割的主視覺，去背木線軸破框而出；水彩插畫，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A kankurenai-red yarn shop set like a poster: a diagonal-split hero, giant type and a cut-out spool breaking the frame.
summary.ja: 韓紅の手染め毛糸店。ポスターのような大きな文字、斜めに切った主役画面、枠を破る切り抜きの糸巻き。水彩画と五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Une mercerie rouge kankurenai composée comme une affiche : héros en diagonale, grands titres et bobine détourée.
summary.de: Ein kankurenai-roter Wollladen wie ein Plakat: diagonal geteilter Hero, riesige Schrift und eine freigestellte Spule.
